front.title: IP Flow Information Export (IPFIX) Information Elements for Bounded-Latency and Residence-Budget Discard Attribution

abstract.t: This document defines IP Flow Information Export (IPFIX) Information Elements and a forwardingStatus (IE 89, Status 10b: Dropped) sub- reason code for attributing packet discards caused by explicit residence-time or delivery-deadline budget expiration in bounded- latency data-center and deterministic networks. The specification standardizes primary-cause precedence over competing drop policies, clock-uncertainty comparison invariants, zero-count interval uncertainty encoding, and deterministic mapping to the IETF device packet-discard reporting model.
